Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The authors note that human relational annotations can be ambiguous compared with formal variables; sequence length and ordering affect accuracy, and gains from supplying correct relational steps do not show the model can infer those steps unaided.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The study added abstract relational plans to arithmetic solutions and contrasted numeric-only, relational-first, interleaved and multitask training formats; in multitask training the model produced relational or numeric sequences on different batches and numeric sequences at test time.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

GSM8K-R extends GSM8K with human annotations pairing solution steps with short abstract relational explanations; annotators were instructed to keep equation structure while consistently naming the quantities. The published instructions include the actual labeling interface.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

With GPT-2-XL and greedy decoding on GSM8K-R, multitask relational training achieved 28.05% top-1 test solve accuracy versus 22.97% for equation-only training; the much higher 66.26% ground-truth-relational-prompt result uses privileged test-time auxiliary information.
